bodyHtml:
The Appia Life builds on the success of the Appia, further pushing the limits of the already proven espresso machine. It is a machine of high productivity and high performance. Combined this with its proven reliability and modern style make it the ideal machine for any room.

The Appia Life Volumetric is the ideal machine for baristas looking for amazingly consistent coffee. Being volumetric this machine allows baristas to program desired volumes and consistently pull shots at that volume throughout the day. Because the barista no longer has to monitor each and every shot, they are given precious time to interact with customers or perhaps begin another order. Making this machine ideal for a number of shops and setups.

Though economically priced, Appia Life has a sleek design, improved brew groups, and shot control buttons. All Appia Life models include standard features like soft infusion, powerful steam with push-pull controls, cool-touch wands with steam tips ideal for micro-foaming, automatic back-flushing, and much more.

    • Suitable for: restaurants, hotels, coffee shops, quick-serve restaurants, offices, and cafes

    • Upgraded raised groups make it easier to fit larger to-go cups underneath your portafilter, and the steam wand will simplify milk-steaming
    • Upgraded cool touch steam wands are double insulated wands that you can touch without burning your hand
    • Optional TFT Digital Display (XT Digit) to easily program espresso shot dosages, brightness, pre-infusion, several maintenance features, on/off times, and display various counters
      • The TFT displays espresso shot times, eliminating the need for external timers (please note, it is not a touchscreen)
    • Large boiler capacity
    • Cup warmer rail
    • Drytex thermal boiler insulation
    • Remote control
    • Reverse Mirror back-plate allows the barista to see inside groups or bottomless portafilters without bending over
    • Portafilters are solid chrome-plated brass with an ergonomic molded handle & rubber grip for minimizing stress on Barista’s wrist
    • Automated Backflushing for fast & easy group cleaning
    • Pressure Gauges display pump & steam pressure, making it easy to check pressure profiles and monitor machine performance
    • Color: Black, White
    • NSF rated

name: Nuova Simonelli Aurelia II  Espresso Machine
description: The Nuova Simonelli Aurelia is an engineering marvel and is the only espresso machine designed using computed theoretical models to achieve temperature stability. In order to achieve its high level of temperature stability, every aspect of the machine had to be perfectly balanced and engineered to exacting standards. The result is an amazing and truly remarkable system that self-stabilizes using its own water and a single heat source to maintain thermal equilibrium. The Aurelia's scientifically designed brew group weighs over 12 pounds and is a key factor in the machine's temperature stability, and it allows the operator to customize the degree of pre-infusion, brew temperature, and flow rate individually. Specifications: Body Material: Stainless steel with ABS insert Boiler Capacity: 14 lt Boiler Material: Copper Semi Auto & Volum Pressostat: Manual Digit & T3 Pressostat: Electronic Voltage: 230-380 V Wattage: 4500 W (Semi, Volu, Dig), 7300 W (T3) Amps: 20 A (Semi, Volu, Dig), 30 (T3)

name: Expobar Coffee Machine Single Group built-in grinder
description: If space in your coffee shop, sandwich bar or even catering van is at a premium, the NC1 High Group espresso machine leaves plenty of room for prep. It’s less than 50cm wide and 60cm deep, but that small footprint doesn’t mean a sacrifice on functionality. Far from it. After all, not every commercial espresso machine features a built-in grinder for barista convenience. Alongside the one group head is a steam wand for frothing and a hot water tap, and there’s a built-in coffee tamper too. As well as pre-infusion, you can adjust coffee dosage from 5g to 12g, according to specialty coffee and the flavor you’re after, and the six-liter on-board boiler will handle any sudden customer rushes. Because it can be run with a 13 amp power supply, you can plug it in virtually anywhere you need to serve great quality coffee.
